text: 财政部：6月份，全国共销售彩票759.78亿元，同比增长39.5%。 1-6月累计，全国共销售彩票3268.74亿元，同比增加90.20亿元，增长2.8%。
text_en: Ministry of Finance: In June, national lottery sales totaled 75.978 billion yuan, up 39.5% year-on-year. For the January-June cumulative period, national lottery sales reached 326.874 billion yuan, an increase of 9.02 billion yuan, or 2.8%, year-on-year.
